SELECT , , , , , ,
FROM video_events video_event JOIN gc_user u ON video_event.owner_id = u.id JOIN gc_user_info user_info ON u.info_id = user_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file user_avatar_file ON user_info.avatar_file_id = user_avatar_file.id LEFT JOIN tasks task ON video_event.id = task.video_event_id AND task.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN task_choices task_choice ON task_choice.task_id = task.id AND task_choice.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN notifications notification ON video_event.id = notification.video_event_id WHERE video_event.video_id = #{videoId} AND video_event.type = #{eventType} ORDER BY video_event.video_time, video_event.order_number
